editorial.why_here: Go to Ka'Tiki, a beach bar since 1982 with an authentic palm thatched roof Tiki bar. Live music plays 7 days a week, and Ka'Tiki serves sandwiches, wings and apps plus a full liquor bar.
editorial.know_before: Ka'Tiki is a 21 and up venue, open from 9 a.m. until 2 a.m. daily
